chunks: What disease is more severe than miserliness?
A false oath leaves homes desolate of their inhabitants.

key_terms.الْبُخْلِ: Miserliness; a blameworthy refusal to give or spend where one should.
key_terms.الْحَيَاءُ: Modesty or moral shame that restrains a person from indecency and wrongdoing.
key_terms.الْيَمِينُ الْفَاجِرَةُ: A sinful or false oath sworn wrongfully.

ai.seo_question: What do the sayings of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم teach about miserliness, modesty, and false oaths?
ai.summary: These concise sayings of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم teach core moral truths: miserliness is a destructive spiritual disease, modesty is wholly virtuous, and sinful false oaths bring ruin. Together, they stress purification of character, truthful conduct, and avoidance of moral corruption in personal and social life.
